Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
DOC-0053 2026-10-20
RETROSPECTIVE — Weekend Cabin Coverage Needed a
Fallback
Date: 2026-10-20
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Recorder: PERSON-0025, TEAM-0001
What happened
The cabin weekend plan reserved contact appointments at 10:40 but did not
give the relief desk an explicit fallback when a receiving coordinator could not
attend. The handover relied on the calendar entry to explain who would take
the next call. ISSUE-0103 and TASK-0274 locate the planning folder.
What helped The dated appointment diary preserved the intended contact and
its purpose. The question parking margin also kept background questions
beside an addressee and promised reply date. Those details let the program
chair distinguish the coverage decision from the separate documentation
discussion located through TASK-0275.
What changes Write a fallback role beside the named receiving coordinator
and confirm the covered interval before the preceding weekday handover. If
the fallback cannot attend, the duty chair must name the next receiving role
and record a contact time. Keep the original appointment visible when the
arrangement changes.
The parking margin remains useful, but coverage uncertainty belongs in the
main decision paragraph. A side question must not hide who carries the next
administrative action. TASK-0276 remains a separate locating reference if
attached papers need discussion.
Follow-up PERSON-0025 will review the fallback line with the weekend roster
clerk on 2026-10-23. The program chair will keep the earlier plan with the
revised coverage sheet so the reason for the change remains clear.
D. Worker 0025
Demo Worker 0025, Demo Team 01 2026-10-29
FILED
